idempotency_key.description: Worker-injected per-step idempotency key; successful identical requests replay, conflicting reuse returns 409. The demo ordering workflow derives this key from the step ID and workflow input order_id. Use a new order_id for each new submission and preserve it for retries; order_id is a workflow input, not a required field on this capability.
